text: You are not putting continents back. You are teaching nine voices to agree again, one camp at a time.
A chalk link is a promise. A seated catalyst is a conversation restarted. A tablet rite is asking politely, smaller than the old world asked.
The March kept the halls, the drums, the tablets. Read every tablet. Strike the Silent Drum when you are ready. Tell the camps we are sorry it took so long.
The world does not snap back. It learns to hold.
